nimbus.title: Nimbus — optimization
nimbus.option.section_culling.tip: Skip entities in occluded world sections (uses the game's visibility graph). Turns itself off under Sodium.
nimbus.option.item.tip: Dropped items beyond this distance are not drawn.
nimbus.option.projectile.tip: Arrows, tridents, snowballs and so on.
nimbus.option.mob.tip: Draw distance for mobs. Bosses and players are always drawn.
nimbus.option.detail.tip: Beyond this, armor, held items and other layers are skipped for mobs (twice as far for players).
nimbus.option.name_tag.tip: Name tag distance for mobs and items (players unaffected).
nimbus.option.block_entity.tip: Signs, chests, heads, banners and modded blocks beyond this are not drawn. Per type in nimbus.json.
nimbus.option.sign_text.tip: Signs beyond this are drawn without text.
nimbus.option.frame_content.tip: Beyond this, items and maps inside frames are not drawn.
nimbus.option.particle_culling.tip: Skip particles outside the view and too far away.
nimbus.option.particle.tip: Particles beyond this are not drawn.
nimbus.option.block_entity_tick.tip: Beyond this, client-side block entity animations are not updated.
nimbus.option.entity_tick.tip: Beyond this, items, orbs and armor stands tick 4 times less often.
nimbus.option.debug_line.tip: Show culling stats in the F3 screen.
nimbus.option.occlusion_culling.tip: Rays from the camera on a separate thread: entities and block entities fully hidden behind opaque blocks are not drawn.
nimbus.option.target_fps.tip: Target FPS: below it, entity, block entity and particle distances shrink smoothly (down to half) and recover once FPS is back.
nimbus.option.render_scale.tip: Render the world at a lower resolution and upscale it; the HUD stays sharp. Big help for weak GPUs. Not with shaders or Fabulous graphics.
nimbus.option.hidden_tick.tip: Mobs that are not visible (far or behind walls, beyond 24 blocks) tick 3 times less often on the client.
nimbus.option.adaptive_resolution.tip: If FPS is still below target after shrinking distances, lower world resolution down to 60%.
nimbus.preset.none.tip: Full quality: nice graphics, Nimbus optimizations stay invisible.
nimbus.preset.subtle.tip: Sacrifice what is rarely noticed: vignette, entity shadows, fancy clouds, biome blend, far details. Good gain, almost no loss.
nimbus.preset.serious.tip: Fast graphics, no smooth lighting or clouds, 75% world resolution with sharpening, fewer particles, no texture animation or weather, shorter detail distances. Big gain.
nimbus.preset.max.tip: Minimum of everything: 50% resolution with sharpening, no sky, beacon beams, break particles, minimal particles and details. Render distance untouched.
nimbus.option.borderless.tip: Windows only: fullscreen as a borderless window, instant alt-tab, no video mode switch. Linux and macOS compositors already do this.
nimbus.option.sharpness.tip: Adaptive sharpening shader: restores detail at lower world resolution. 0 = off.
nimbus.option.sky.tip: Sun, moon, stars and sky colour. Without it the background is fog colour.
nimbus.option.fog.tip: Distance fog (kept underwater, in lava and when blinded).
nimbus.option.beacon_beams.tip: Draw beacon and end gateway beams.
nimbus.option.enchanting_book.tip: Draw the floating book above enchanting tables.
nimbus.option.piston_animation.tip: Draw blocks while a piston moves them. When off, the block disappears while it moves.
nimbus.option.instant_sneak.tip: The camera lowers instantly when sneaking, with no smooth transition.
nimbus.option.animated_textures.tip: Water, lava, fire, portals and other animated textures. Turning off saves CPU and VRAM bandwidth.
nimbus.option.block_break_particles.tip: Fragments when breaking and mining blocks.
nimbus.option.render_ahead.tip: How many frames the CPU may queue ahead of the GPU. Lower = less input lag, higher = smoother under load. Off = driver default.
nimbus.option.anim.other.tip: Everything else: command blocks, prismarine, mods.
nimbus.option.fog_distance.tip: Where fog starts, percent of normal. Higher pushes fog farther.
nimbus.option.cloud_height.tip: Cloud height in blocks (default = game value).
nimbus.option.steady_debug.tip: Debug screen updates every 100 ms instead of every frame, so it stops eating FPS.
nimbus.option.fps_overlay.tip: Show FPS and the 1-second minimum in a corner.
nimbus.option.fast_states.tip: Block states share one neighbour lookup per block instead of a table each. −25 MB vanilla, much more in modpacks. Turns off with FerriteCore. Needs restart.
nimbus.option.dedup_models.tip: Identical model vertex data is stored once (~40% duplicates). Needs restart.
nimbus.option.leaves_culling.tip: Skip inner leaf faces. Depth keeps a fluffy outer layer, All gives the most speed. Helps on Fancy graphics, especially in forests.
nimbus.option.beacon_culling.tip: Skip beacon beams outside the view (the game always draws them).
nimbus.option.sign_back_culling.tip: Skip sign text that faces away from you.
nimbus.option.chest_models.tip: Closed chests are drawn in the chunk mesh like regular blocks — almost free; opening switches to the normal animation. Off when Enhanced Block Entities is installed.
nimbus.option.background_fps.tip: Frame cap when the game window is not focused.
nimbus.option.minimized_fps.tip: Frame cap when the game is minimized — almost no load.
nimbus.option.afk_minutes.tip: Minutes without mouse or keyboard before lowering FPS.
nimbus.option.background_volume.tip: Game volume when the window is not focused (100% = unchanged).
nimbus.option.stream_uploads.tip: Mobs, items and interface are uploaded to the GPU through one persistent ring buffer instead of reallocating a buffer for every batch. Off when ImmediatelyFast is installed. Requires restart.
nimbus.option.biome_cache.tip: Sky and fog colour, ambient block effects: repeated biome lookups within a tick are served from a cache. Same result as vanilla.
nimbus.option.fast_biome_blend.tip: Grass, foliage and water colours are sampled once per section layer while building a chunk and blurred in two passes. Same colours as vanilla, much faster chunk builds with a large blend radius.
nimbus.option.fast_clouds.tip: Clouds are meshed once in white and tinted by the shader, so time-of-day and weather colour changes no longer rebuild the cloud mesh.
nimbus.option.entity_light_cache.tip: Mob and item lighting is read from the light engine once per tick instead of every frame.
nimbus.option.entity_grouping.tip: Entities of the same kind are drawn together, so the GPU switches textures less often.
nimbus.option.entity_batching.tip: Models of all entities of one kind are collected and sent to the GPU in one call instead of piece by piece for every part of every mob.
nimbus.option.map_atlas.tip: All maps share one texture, so a wall of maps in item frames is drawn in a single call.
nimbus.option.particle_light_cache.tip: Particle lighting is read from the light engine once per tick instead of every frame, since particles only move on ticks.
nimbus.option.weather_cache.tip: Height, biome, precipitation and light for rain and snow are computed once per tick per column instead of every frame.
nimbus.option.fluid_cache.tip: Mobs standing still do not check for water every tick; the check reruns when they move and every half second.
nimbus.option.section_light_cache.tip: While building a chunk, light at each position is computed once per section instead of again for every neighbouring block.
nimbus.option.nimbus_mesher.tip: Nimbus builds chunk geometry straight into its renderer format with no intermediate repacking, so chunks build faster.
nimbus.option.gpu_frustum.tip: The video card picks the chunks in view every frame, so turning the camera costs the processor almost nothing.
nimbus.option.gpu_occlusion.tip: The video card hides chunks that are fully covered by hills and buildings before drawing them. Most effective in caves, cities and mountains.
nimbus.option.terrain_renderer.tip: Own chunk renderer: half-size vertex data in one GPU buffer, each layer drawn with a single multi-draw call. Needs OpenGL 4.6, falls back to vanilla otherwise; inactive when Sodium is installed.
nimbus.option.bed_models.tip: Beds are baked into the chunk mesh instead of being drawn as block entities every frame. Off with Enhanced Block Entities.
nimbus.option.shulker_models.tip: Closed shulker boxes are part of the chunk mesh; the opening animation still plays. Off with Enhanced Block Entities.
nimbus.option.gui_batching.tip: Consecutive interface sprites with the same texture (hearts, hunger, armor, hotbar, buttons) are drawn in one call. Off when ImmediatelyFast is installed.
nimbus.option.sign_models.tip: Sign boards (standing and wall) are baked into the chunk mesh and stay visible at any distance; only the text is drawn per frame. Off with Enhanced Block Entities.
nimbus.option.render_engine.tip: Which engine draws the terrain. Nimbus: own renderer with compact vertices, multi-draw and GPU-friendly culling (experimental). With Sodium installed this choice will appear once the Nimbus renderer no longer depends on the vanilla pipeline.
nimbus.option.full_settings.tip: Opens the full Nimbus screen: Sacrifice presets, per-particle-type toggles and everything else.
nimbus.option.sodium_graph_cache.tip: Sodium walks the chunk visibility graph every frame, even when you only turn the camera. Nimbus walks it once per section change or chunk update and only filters the result by the view each frame. Sodium 0.8 only.
nimbus.preset.custom.tip: Settings were changed by hand. Pick a preset to replace them.
nimbus.option.bell_models.tip: A resting bell is part of the chunk mesh; when rung it swings as in vanilla. Off with Enhanced Block Entities.
nimbus.option.pot_models.tip: Decorated pots are drawn with the chunk instead of a separate model every frame. While a pot wobbles after a hit it is drawn as usual.
nimbus.screen.title: Settings
nimbus.screen.hint: Hover over a setting to see what it does. Right-click a setting to reset it. Changes take effect when you press Apply or Done.
nimbus.screen.restart: Some changes take effect after a restart
nimbus.presets.tip: Ready-made sets of settings. Picking one applies it right away; changing any setting afterwards switches to Custom.
nimbus.engine.no_gl46: OpenGL 4.6 is required, the vanilla renderer draws the world
nimbus.engine.failed: The engine failed to start, the vanilla renderer draws the world. See the log
nimbus.option.own_traversal.tip: Section search with a view margin instead of the vanilla background graph. Reruns only when the camera leaves the margin or sections change.
nimbus.option.own_translucent_sort.tip: Water and glass are sorted on worker threads straight from packed vertices; the main thread only uploads the result. Flat water surfaces are not sorted at all.
